description:
Job Description: 
 The role would be for configuring and setting up Service-now ITSM application and maintain and support the implementation. This person will work very closely with ITSM Process Architect, customer personnel, Business Analyst(s), IT Architect, IT support teams and other technical teams to ensure that business needs around implementation of ITSM processes and ServiceNow (Service-now.com) in a controlled and predictive manner. 
 The general scope of the work for this position is as follows: 

 Understands technical and functional design requirements for ServiceNow 

 Understands the workflow engines
 Creates workflow and web prototypes for client engagements
 Designs, codes, and tests technical solutions for ServiceNow implementations
 Uses Mid server, webservices, email and other relevant technology to integrate tools with ServiceNow.
 Administer and troubleshoot the deployed instance of ServiceNow.
 Identifies system deficiencies and recommends solutions
 Assists in enforcement of development deadlines and schedules
 Understands the necessity of and contributes to coding standards
 Develops internal and external meeting objectives and agendas 
 Prioritizes multiple tasks effectively. 
 Promotes active listening with team members. 
 Contributes appropriately to conversations. 
 Follows through with commitments and fosters mutual trust with fellow employees. 
 Assumes additional responsibility without being asked. 
 Encourages fellow team members to make innovative contributions and embrace new ideas.
 
 QUALIFICATIONS: 

 IT or Web programming related educational background 

 The candidate should be trained in ITILv3 foundation certified
 Service-now trained with prior experience in at least 1 implementation/support of ServiceNow.
 At least 5-7 years of IT experience in development/support/analyst positions in Service Management tools such as BMC Remedy, HP SM, BMC Remedy on Demand
 Experience with JavaScript, XML and XSL stylesheets 
 Able to Read and understands XML schemas 
 Understanding of Software as a Service 
 Understanding of client server architecture 
 Understanding of SOA and Web Services concepts
 Should have prior experience in integrating tools in ServiceNow or other similar tools using MidServer, Webservices, email etc..
 
 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6 Months
